title: Ensuring Responsible AI Governance
summary: The development and implementation of AI ethics and governance frameworks are crucial for ensuring that AI becomes a force for good. This requires transparency, global collaboration, and the involvement of diverse stakeholders. Effective governance can help mitigate risks and promote responsible AI practices.

patterns.statement: AI governance should prioritize transparency, diversity, and inclusivity
Ethical frameworks for AI should be aligned with institutional mission and values

contrasts.statement: There is a tension between adapting existing governance structures to accommodate AI and creating new frameworks that address the unique challenges of AI
Different regions may have varying approaches to AI regulation, highlighting the need for global cooperation
